(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 109 Questi la caccerà per ogne villa, 110 fin che l'avrà rimessa ne lo 'nferno, 111 là onde 'nvidia prima dipartilla. Reference Translation (provided): He shall hunt her through every town till he shall have set her back in hell, there whence envy first sent her forth.

**Step 1 – Interpretation Lock (one bullet per source line)**
- **Line 109** – *Questi la caccerà per ogne villa* → **Locked Meaning**: There exists an agent **Questi** (the male figure) such that, in the future, he will **hunt** the patient **la** (her) **through every town** (for each location *villa*).
- **Line 110** – *fin che l’avrà rimessa ne lo ’nferno* → **Locked Meaning**: The hunting continues **until** the moment at which the agent **will have set** the patient **l’** (her) **back in hell** (*ne lo ’nferno*).
- **Line 111** – *là onde ’nvidia prima dipartilla* → **Locked Meaning**: At that place (**là**), **envy** (*’nvidia*) is the **first** cause that **sent** the patient **her** (*la*) **forth**.

*Notes*
- The Italian **‘nvidia** is the elided form of **l’invidia**; the article is omitted in the English translation because the noun functions as a proper abstract agent. - **dipartilla** combines the verb *dipartire* (“to send forth, dispatch”) with the clitic *‑la* (“her”), mirroring the English “sent her forth.” - The future‑perfect construction **avrà rimessa** corresponds to “shall have set back,” marking the endpoint of the hunting episode.
